elicitation_input.question: Which US TV show, for which the cast list included Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Michael Richards and Jason Alexander, was set predominantly in an apartment block on New York City's Upper West Side (but shot mostly in Los Angeles, California)?

llm_generation.text:
That would be **Seinfeld**, the iconic sitcom created by Jerry Seinfeld and Larry David that aired from 1989 to 1998.

The show starred Jerry Seinfeld as a fictionalized version of himself, alongside Julia Louis-Dreyfus as Elaine Benes, Michael Richards as Cosmo Kramer, and Jason Alexander as George Costanza. Much of the action centered around Jerry's apartment building, supposedly located on the Upper West Side of Manhattan, along with frequent visits to the neighborhood diner (exterior shots used Tom's Restaurant in New York).

Despite its distinctly New York setting and sensibility, the series was actually filmed primarily at CBS Studio Center in Studio City, Los Angeles, with occasional location shooting in New York for exterior scenes. The show became one of the most influential and successful sitcoms in television history, often celebrated for its "show about nothing" premise and its focus on the minutiae of everyday life.
